resources.name: All-electron full-potential DFT code (e.g., Elk or Quantum ESPRESSO with PAW)

access.notes: Alternative: Quantum ESPRESSO (https://www.quantum-espresso.org) with PAW. Must support GGA-PBE and TBmBJ exchange.

resources.notes: Used for all DFT calculations: structural optimization, total energies, band structure, and electron density.

resources.name: Bader charge analysis program

access.notes: Henkelman group's Bader code. Some DFT codes have built-in Bader analysis.

resources.notes: Optional tool for Bader charge analysis. If unavailable, the Bader step can be skipped or given reduced weight.

resources.name: Initial crystal structures of AlH3 polymorphs

access.notes: Space groups and approximate lattice parameters: α (R-3c, a≈4.46 Å, c≈11.73 Å), β (Fd-3m, a≈9.09 Å), γ (Pnmm, a≈5.45 Å, b≈7.45 Å, c≈5.82 Å), α' (Cmcm, a≈6.60 Å, b≈11.15 Å, c≈6.62 Å). Exact initial coordinates are available from ICSD or literature; the workflow will relax them.

resources.notes: Public initial structures. The exact values do not need to match the paper's initial guess because they are relaxed.
